# Valve DMX reader

`valve_datamodel.py` is the MIT-licensed reader by Tom Edwards distributed with
Blender Source Tools (`io_scene_valvesource/datamodel.py`). The embedded license
is retained. It supports Source 2 binary DMX version 9, which the current
srctools reader cannot read. Used to preserve Source 2's authored LOD meshes.

Upstream: https://github.com/Artfunkel/BlenderSourceTools
